prompts.home:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: textless circular LCD background for a 360x360 ESP32 demo.
Input image: the attached 8-screen design board is the exact visual reference and edit target.
Extract and recreate ONLY the circular artwork from screen 01, top-left HOME. Output a single square image, with the complete circle exactly centered and occupying 98% of the square, black outside the circle. No poster, no headings, no contact sheet.
Preserve the reference's rich bright antique-gold concentric filigree frame, four delicate cardinal-point ornaments, very dark blue-green sky, luminous warm golden moon behind the upper center-right, ornate blue-and-gold phoenix on the LEFT with flowing feathers, misty teal mountains and pavilions along the lower edge, small ivory and gold clouds at the border. Preserve the phoenix pose and gold engraved illustration quality as closely as possible.
Remove ALL interface text, date, time, location, weather icons, numeric values, buttons, panels and calendar glyph. Fill these removed areas with continuous scene artwork. Center and right must retain the original quiet deep teal-black negative space for later dynamic UI, particularly x=45%-80%, y=24%-76%. Keep scenery intricate around the edges, not across that text area. Moon and phoenix may be rich, but no replacement typography.
No lettering, no numerals, no logo, no UI data, no progress rings. Full circle fully visible, crisp fine ornament, avoid thick simplified cartoon border. This is a background asset, NOT a completed UI screenshot.
prompts.weather:

Image 1 is the exact 8-screen reference board; Image 2 is the selected home background and is ONLY a reference for identical gold frame geometry, ornament scale, engraved illustration style and palette. Output ONE square artwork, complete centered gold circle occupying 98% of square, pure black outside. Match Image 2's thin multilayer bright antique-gold circular frame and four small teal-jewel cardinal-point ornaments. Intricate refined teal-blue, ivory-cloud and engraved-gold Chinese mythological illustration. Preserve the specified panel's composition in Image 1, rather than replacing with a generic fantasy scene. Remove ALL text, letters, numerals, headings, logos, interface widgets, progress rings, weather icons and button panels. Reconstruct quiet dark sky behind removed UI. No poster, no montage, no UI screenshot, no watermark. Background asset only.
Use the circular artwork in panel 02 TOP ROW SECOND, WEATHER DETAIL. Golden moon in upper-left near the border at x=32%, y=17%, with fine ivory clouds framing upper-left and the perimeter. Layered steep teal mountains and distant traditional gold-roof pavilions around the LOWER and SIDE edges. A misty lake landscape in bottom 20%. Wide continuous deep teal-black negative space in the CENTRAL region x=26%-80%, y=27%-81% for temperature and four weather rows. No bird or large beast. Preserve the fine moonlit cloudscape and reference balance.
